code.title: Code
code.description: Stable machine-readable error code; no request inputs are echoed.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.description: Supported optional API features; absent means legacy.

next_before.title: Next Before
next_before.description: Cursor for the preceding page; null when has_more is false.

turns.title: Turns
turns.description: Up to 30 turns in chronological order. Only message, preferences, done, notice and the latest listings result set in this page are retained in this response.

client_conversation_id.title: Client Conversation Id
client_conversation_id.description: Persist before creation and reuse with identical initial preferences when retrying. The key is scoped to the authenticated user; a conflicting retry returns idempotency_conflict.

replace.title: Replace
replace.description: Replace the current result set, preserving item order.

PendingPayload.title: PendingPayload
PendingPayload.description: Replay is a snapshot; poll again after pending to read later durable events.

status.title: Status
status.description: Provider progress or source error code. Known progress values include batch, complete, recently_checked, updating, temporarily_unavailable and timeout. Other values describe source failures and must be handled as an incomplete refresh.

count.title: Count
count.description: Records accepted for this batch or completed provider refresh.

recovery_code.title: Recovery Code
recovery_code.description: Reusable 256-bit account credential. Shown only upon creation/rotation; keep it private in a password manager. Rotation invalidates the previous code.

SSEStreamSchema.description: UTF-8 Server-Sent Events framed as id, event and JSON data fields, followed by a blank line. x-event-schema describes one parsed event. Unknown event names may be added; clients should ignore them. Replay uses after, not Last-Event-ID.
